title: AA Academy module quiz
description: docs/learn/modules/<ID>-<slug>/quiz.yaml: 5 to 10 retrieval items, each citing the source section it tests. The pass mark and retake delay are settings, never in this file (GUIDE-13 §7.4). Checked by tools/docs/check_learn.py (AA-1104).

id.description: <module id>-Q<n>, e.g. F3-Q1. Never reused for a different question.

answer.description: Zero-based indexes of the correct choices.

source.description: One of the module's lesson source refs, with an anchor; the item is suspended when that section changes.

explain.description: Shown after the answer: why it is right, in one or two sentences.
